profile.regional_context: Per DataCenterDynamics, NBC4, and Construction Dive, Google acquired an initial 85 acre site in New Albany, opened a first Ohio data center reported at approximately $600 million (per The New Albany Company), and announced a combined $1.7 billion investment across new Columbus and Lancaster, Ohio data center campuses. This places Google alongside AWS and Meta as a major hyperscale investor in the same New Albany/Licking County corridor.
profile.disclosure_policy: Google publishes aggregate state level investment figures on its data center location pages but does not publish exact addresses, square footage, or MW capacity for individual buildings
